title: helldivers.bot
description: A Helldivers dashboard and API with operational and feature improvements.
prose:
## Blockers

- HOUSE-03 (sourcemap stripping): v0.95.2 uploaded sourcemaps and GlitchTip symbolicates 0.95.2 events (turbopack frames resolve to source paths in the recount), so #502 can proceed in Phase 2
- [M7] Production `/opengraph-image` serves the static fallback on every request (sharp rejection on x64 production, not reproduced on arm64) — #503
- [M7] Hydration #418 still fires on `/` for real browsers on 0.95.2 — #496, #526
- [M7] Code review WR-01..11 recorded open in `milestones/M7-phases/01-stability-fixes-release/01-REVIEW-DISPOSITION.md`; WR-08 (shared-cache HTML with session-dependent admin widget) and WR-07 (unconditional Umami proxy rewrite) deserve Phase 2 triage first
- SITE-03 and ARCH-08 touch the same narrative/vernacular copy — Phase 14 depends on Phase 12 so the second track consumes the first's vocabulary source instead of forking it
- ICE-06/ICE-07 and STAGE-01..04 are gated on external factors (official API behavior, TLS pinning, homelab hardware) — not schedulable by effort alone

## Decisions

Decisions are logged in PROJECT.md Key Decisions table.
Recent decisions affecting current work:

- Roadmap: HOUSE-01 (test co-location) is a standalone Phase 3 that must land before any phase adding tests (5, 7, 8, 9, 10, 11, 12, 13, 15, 17)
- Roadmap: SEO & Analytics Foundation (Phase 5) is inserted right after Test Co-location and Dependency Cleanup, before every feature track — ranking compounds with time. It absorbs HOUSE-02's Rich Results/Schema.org/Search Console checks into SEO-05, and depends on STAB-02's OG fallback (M7) and Phase 3 (tests)
- Roadmap: LOAD-01/02/03 (catalogs + hash codec) is a standalone Phase 7 — the milestone's one-way door — before any Loadout UI
- Roadmap: New public pages shipped by Loadout Builder Core (Phase 8) and Archive Analytics (Phases 11, 12) register in the sitemap/llms.txt/metadata registry per the SEO-02/04 convention established in Phase 5
- Roadmap: SSE (Phase 17) is spike-gated and scheduled after staging (Phase 16) so it can test against real multi-replica topology; "don't implement" is a valid outcome
- Roadmap: Final Documentation Pass (Phase 18) also runs SEO-07's recurring Search Console review; findings become GitHub issues rather than inline fixes
- [Phase 02]: docs/roadmap.md deleted, not a pointer (supersedes D-19/D-20): .planning/ROADMAP.md is the one roadmap file; live items carried into ROADMAP.md § Carried over; plan 02-03 done outside execute-phase (2026-11-02)

## Sources

STATE.md and ROADMAP.md at baedce55 (2026-11-09): [STATE.md](https://github.com/elfensky/helldivers.bot/blob/baedce5517026883bf27556ba63ce897db4fd106/.planning/STATE.md), [ROADMAP.md](https://github.com/elfensky/helldivers.bot/blob/baedce5517026883bf27556ba63ce897db4fd106/.planning/ROADMAP.md).

milestones.title: The first site caches the war and draws the map
milestones.summary: The first site caches the Helldivers 1 API in Postgres, serves it again in the game's format, and shows the map, stats and timeline.

milestones.title: The rebuilt dashboard works on every screen
milestones.summary: The relaunched site makes the live war dashboard its homepage and works on phone, tablet and desktop, with notifications and accounts.

milestones.title: The archive holds every season in five tables
milestones.summary: Every season sits in a normalized five-table schema with bucket upserts, and the archives and the new /stats page read it.

milestones.title: Developers can use a public API
milestones.summary: Developers query versioned `/api/v1/h1` endpoints with API keys, rate limits and an OpenAPI document, released to `main` as v0.59.0.

milestones.title: The archives tell each season's story
milestones.summary: The archives and `/stats` explain each season through combat telemetry, engagement, a written war narrative and faction markers.

milestones.title: The dashboard predicts the next events
milestones.summary: The dashboard forecasts the next wave, the assault timing and the counterattack clock, and the develop backlog ships from v0.90.4 on.

milestones.title: Production is stable on the Hetzner swarm
milestones.summary: The known production bug classes are fixed or tracked, and production runs on the Hetzner swarm, released as v0.96.4.

milestones.title: The site is documented, tested and findable
milestones.summary: The docs match the code, tests sit beside their modules, dependency updates merge themselves, and search and analytics are wired in.

milestones.title: Players can build and share loadouts
milestones.summary: A player builds a loadout, sees its stats and shares it as a link with its own preview image, up to a full four-player squad.

milestones.title: Players can explore season analytics
milestones.summary: Players read season-level analytics, stories and comparisons across all 160 seasons, and charts hide when a season has no telemetry.

milestones.title: The site is accessible and polished
milestones.summary: The site meets WCAG contrast and ARIA rules, admins can broadcast, and the map gains depth; the two Icebox spikes reach a decision.

milestones.title: Staging runs on the Pi and live updates are decided
milestones.summary: A push to `develop` deploys to staging on the Pi swarm, a spike decides on SSE against polling, and the public docs describe what shipped.
